day_shape: 66 items: Khamenei issues 13 Aban message declaring 'end of American invincibility', IRGC claims four oil tankers hit mines near Strait of Hormuz, Iran Human Rights reports 77 October executions, US–Iran talks reportedly stalled with renewed-strike speculation.

threads.label: Khamenei 13 Aban message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released and amplified a message for the National Day of Struggle Against Global Arrogance declaring the 'end of the myth of American invincibility' and promoting the 'ever-stronger Iran' strategy as the path to absolute deterrence. IRIB and Defa Press carried matching statements from First VP Arif, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bagheri and Defence spokesperson Talaiyanik, alongside photos of Zanjan rallies.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker mine incident
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported the IRGC's statement that four oil tankers were destroyed after striking naval mines south of the Strait of Hormuz on a route it described as prohibited. Iran International reported Tehran is seeking Chinese and Russian backing in Hormuz-related talks with Washington, with analysis of repeated US strikes on Qeshm Island.

threads.label: US–Iran talks, renewed-strike speculation
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post sources said US–Iran talks have stalled while Washington reinforces regional forces, and Trump told the Financial Times the US has no immediate plan to renew strikes. Iran International reported Tehran internet outages after NYT reporting that strikes could come as early as Wednesday, Israeli warnings of possible Iranian chemical-weapons use, and German FM Wadephul saying Araghchi regularly requests talks.

threads.label: Regime commentary on US midterms
threads.summary: IRIB and Khamenei advisor Mohammad Makhber framed Republican midterm losses as a defeat for Trump and a vindication of Iran, with IRIB citing Nikki Haley and a Guardian column headlined 'death knell of Trumpism'. Jerusalem Post analysis argued Iran could 'simply outlast' Trump following the vote.

threads.label: Iran executions and domestic repression
threads.summary: Norway-based Iran Human Rights said at least 77 people were executed in Iran in October, bringing the 2026 total to 691 including 36 protesters. Iran International also reported a Tehran student sit-in after a doctoral student's self-immolation, and said 20-year-old protester Amirhossein Maleki was subjected to a mock hanging before his Isfahan execution.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Israeli border operations
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said six Palestinian operatives from Hamas, the Army of Islam and Islamic Jihad were killed in three strikes in Khan Younis earlier this week, naming sniper-cell commander Mahmoud Jihad Mohammad Qafa. The Defence Ministry's Borders and Seam Directorate began upgrading the 'Hourglass' fence along Gaza, and UN partners reported only half their Gaza waste-collection fleet is operational.

threads.label: Lebanon and Syria Hezbollah pressure
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported on Syrian government operations against Hezbollah-linked networks since Assad's December 2024 fall, and on cemetery vandalism and claims about a priest's murder reigniting sectarian tensions in Lebanon over Hezbollah's arms. Times of Israel profiled former SLA-linked Lebanese Christian Jonathan Elkhoury.

These pages and channels have no affiliation or connection with the judiciary and their operation and revenue generation is not for this institution. Considering that the official electronic services arm of the judiciary operates on Bale messenger with the username adliran, the people are requested to access judicial services only through the official portals and platforms of the judiciary...

events.title: An army Humvee stolen from a base in southern Israel last week was located by police officers this evening in a community near the Gaza Strip. The vehicle had been identified as missing from the Julis base near Ashkelon on Thursday, prompting an investigation. Police say officers from the Segev Shalom station located the Humvee hidden in a packing factory in the community of Ami'oz, following intelligence information on the vehicle's location. No suspects have been detained yet in the case.
